title: Finiteness of veering triangulations
summary: We show that a finite volume cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold admits at most finitely many veering triangulations, and in fact this number is bounded above by the number of Giroux torsion free tight contact structures. This resolves Kirby problem K3 3.21e. More generally, for any 3-manifold $M$ and any link $L$, we show finiteness for the family of pseudo-Anosov flows which admits a \emph{strictly positive Birkhoff section relative to $L$}.
